note: GROUNDWORK PLATFORM DEFAULT — applies to every tenant unless overridden per-tenant via /finance/config. Feature flags for Finance OS automation. Turning something off here degrades gracefully to a review queue, never to silent skipping — e.g. classifier_enabled: false means every transaction becomes a manual-review action_item, not that transactions go unprocessed. A tenant that wants different automation behavior sets its own override; this file is the platform-wide starting point for every tenant.
